issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing tokens or network failures.
The skill is vendor-locked to Axiom and relies on specific SDKs and environment variables, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: sdk-ingest-with-custom-field
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric, while Response B uses a different SDK and does not import Axiom from @axiomhq/js, failing the key requirements.

scenarios.name: pino-transport-setup
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric items but omits a logger.error example, while Response B uses the wrong transport target and hardcodes the dataset, failing key requirements.

scenarios.name: cli-query-top-errors
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the query requirements but omits the AXIOM_TOKEN note, while Response A fails to provide an axiom query at all.
